_comment: Model keys are what appears in tables. Tags must exist in the Ollama library; run `ollama pull <tag>` for each before running.

main.description: Every model x every task, greedy decoding. Source of all quality and latency numbers.

temperature.description: Sampling ablation on the Q4 models. T=0 comes from the main preset.

smoke.description: Two items per task on one model, to check the setup in a few minutes.

cpu_only.description: Same as main but with GPU offload disabled (num_gpu=0), to measure CPU-only inference on a machine that has a GPU. Run with --machine intel_i7_cpu.

cost_model_assumptions._comment: Illustrative only. Replace with times you actually measure (e.g. time yourselves writing 5 replies by hand). Reported as a sensitivity analysis, never as a finding.
